faqs.q: Can I start with a leak or a small repair?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle roof leak diagnostics, flashing repairs, and storm damage. Tell us what you’ve noticed and when it began—or snap a driveway photo in the AI Dock and you don’t need to diagnose the cause first.

faqs.q: Do you also handle gutters, skylights, and attic ventilation?
faqs.a: Yes. Proper attic ventilation, underlayment/decking repair, gutter installation & cleaning, and skylight flashing work together with your shingles to protect the structure underneath.

faqs.q: Where are you based and what areas do you cover?
faqs.a: Based in Hooksett, NH (146 Londonderry Turnpike) serving Manchester, Dover, Nottingham, Londonderry, Concord, Nashua, and all of Southern New Hampshire.

faqs.q: Can I include photos with my question or quote request?
faqs.a: Yes! Upload up to 3 photos (JPG, PNG, or WebP). Our client-side optimizer resizes them automatically and runs a Vision AI pre-scan for our estimator.

faqs.q: How do ballpark ranges and inspections work?
faqs.a: Our AI assistant provides transparent local ballpark ranges right away based on our contractor pricing table, and helps you lock in a confirmed on-site inspection slot.
